execution_policy: Research inventory only; not accepted by runner as an experiment config. No downloads, training, model loads or automatic candidate sweeps. Promote one selected entry to a pinned executable config after prerequisites are satisfied.

requires: memory-valid MLX repair baseline and screen
supported task-boundary cache clear or matched per-attempt server restarts
byte-bounded retained cache and hybrid-state compatibility
candidates.comparison: Cache disabled versus task-scoped bounded cache, same restart boundaries and stable schema.
candidates.stop: Reject if memory becomes invalid or saved prefill does not exceed cache/reset overhead.

requires: complete no-speculation screen
verified clearing of shared ngram pool between tasks or matched per-attempt process restarts
candidates.comparison: ngram-simple versus ngram-mod, identical cold-pool boundaries; both also compared with no speculation.
candidates.stop: Reject cross-task pool contamination, lost repairs, unsafe memory or no net speedup.

requires: beneficial or diagnostically useful fixed-ngram screen
engine adapter for variable draft lengths and accepted-token counters
bounded task-local index
correct JSON/token matching and hybrid rollback
candidates.comparison: Fixed ngram versus bounded suffix lookup and adaptive draft lengths; include no-speculation action. Train/tune only on development traces.
candidates.stop: Reject if controller/index overhead cancels savings, repair losses occur, or memory rises beyond the envelope.

requires: resident target baseline with spare memory
exact target-compatible draft artifact, revision, hash, size and license
pinned engine/native tools/sampling and state-restoration validation
disk preflight and explicit artifact selection
candidates.comparison: Same target with and without compatible diffusion drafter; same quantization, prompts and budgets.
candidates.stop: Reject if extra residency causes pressure, tool validity fails, repair yield falls, or end-to-end time does not improve.

requires: target baseline and complete screen
select ONE supported target-specific head/drafter
exact artifact provenance and additional footprint
sampling/state correctness gate
candidates.comparison: Chosen compatible drafter versus no speculation. Separate configurations for MTP, EAGLE-3 or DSpark; never combine in the first arm.
candidates.stop: Reject poor amortization, state/tool failures, memory invalidity or repair loss.

requires: viable baseline with context growth/redundancy evidence
tokenizer/template budget accounting
exact versioned source spans and complete tool-message groups
dedup-reference invalidation when evidence is evicted
candidates.comparison: Existing bounded reads versus logged evidence selection by marginal coverage per token; same task report, no oracle feedback.
candidates.stop: Reject dangling tool references, silent evidence corruption or fewer repairs even if token counts fall.

requires: streaming engine with explicit adjustable expert/conversation cache budgets
active and retained memory accounting
measured marginal latency per MiB
safe between-request changes with hysteresis
candidates.comparison: Fixed allocations versus allocation by measured time saved per MiB under the same total memory envelope.
candidates.stop: Reject allocation oscillation, pressure, increased total time or repair loss.

requires: selected viable streaming backend
native expert routing traces and physical I/O counters
reactive baseline and cache replay headroom
bounded transfer predictor that never overrides native routing
candidates.comparison: Reactive routing/cache, then coalesced reads, then bounded history/cross-layer prefetch, then learned SpecPrefetch-style predictor; one factor per arm.
candidates.stop: Reject native routing changes or transfer costs exceeding saved stalls; hit rate alone cannot promote.

requires: one selected small diffusion checkpoint with exact provenance and tool-call capability
working Apple runtime and quantization path
measured fit and cold start
same Go CLI tool protocol adapter
candidates.comparison: Selected diffusion stack against the resident autoregressive winner. Then one Fast-dLLM/cache or confidence-profile change at a time; stack comparisons are not isolated engine gains.
candidates.stop: Reject slower complete repairs, insufficient tool capability, unsafe memory or degraded repair quality.

requires: choose one specifically trained checkpoint
exact artifact size/hash/license and Apple runtime
native tool-call gate and real repair fit
candidates.comparison: Separate model-stack comparisons: LayerSkip-trained self-speculation or native low-bit model. Do not apply arbitrary layer dropping or label post-training quantization as BitNet.
candidates.stop: Reject model substitution with inadequate repair quality despite reduced memory.

requires: measured KV footprint material to memory limit
completed conservative Q8 comparison
supported quantized cache kernels for selected architecture
candidates.comparison: Q8 baseline versus one lower-bit or asymmetric cache method; no simultaneous weight quantization change.
candidates.stop: Reject if smaller cache adds too much compute or loses repairs; paper benchmark wins are not local evidence.
